_comment: Snapshot of the Square Appointments catalogue for Disco Sundays LLC (Hanover, MD). Square is the source of truth. This file is regenerated automatically by scripts/sync-square.mjs when SQUARE_ACCESS_TOKEN is set. Do not hand-edit prices here; change them in Square.

services.name: Creator Membership / Personal Audio Engineer Plan
services.description: Personal Audio Engineer Plan / Full Membership in Hanover Location. A personal audio engineer handles all your audio needs. Available only in Hanover. Sessions include mixing and live video performance.

services.name: Disco Sundays Crash Test
services.description: A 1-hour artist evaluation designed to assess your sound, performance, and direction, while mapping out your next steps as an artist.
longDescription: The Disco Sundays Crash Test is a structured, one-hour artist development session built to evaluate where you are in your journey and how to take you to the next level.
This is not just a studio session. It's a full creative assessment.
includes: Discuss your sound, goals, and current stage as an artist
Evaluate your music, performance, and delivery
Test your presence in the booth or live performance
Identify strengths and areas for improvement
Introduce you to the Disco Sundays development platform
services.outcome: At the end of the session, you'll receive a clear, professional recommendation on your next steps, whether that's recording, development, or preparing for live performance opportunities. This isn't an audition. It's your blueprint.

longDescription: Disco Sundays' membership is designed to help musicians, producers, DJs, and creative entrepreneurs grow their skills and careers through structured courses, community support, and practical projects.
You get a username and password in order to sign in and book sessions.
